clips.title: Turning OFF Ray Tracing Changes Everything
clips.hook: The Steam Machine just got WAY better
clips.reason: Clear before/after payoff where the streamer reacts to a big visual and performance jump after dropping ray tracing and FSR.​

clips.title: GTA 5 Shootout Stress Test on Steam Machine
clips.reason: Gunfight and wanted stars as a real stress test with natural reactions like running out of ammo and the stars climbing.​

clips.title: 1080p Instantly Hits 120 FPS
clips.hook: Wait... is FSR on?? 120 FPS native
clips.reason: Surprised disbelief at triple-digit native frame rates with no FSR or frame gen makes a punchy performance reveal.​

clips.title: 1440p Is The Sweet Spot for Steam Machine
clips.hook: This is THE way to play GTA 5
clips.reason: Clear verdict with stable 90-100 FPS at 1440p, delivering a quotable recommendation viewers want.​

clips.title: Ray Tracing Cuts Your FPS in Half
clips.hook: Ray tracing is NOT worth it
clips.reason: Dramatic FPS drop on screen followed by a hot take, a strong debate-starter for comments.​

clips.title: GTA Online on Steam Machine: 70+ FPS in a Dense City
clips.hook: GTA Online is crazy on this thing
clips.reason: Quick reactions plus a solid FPS result in a busy city give a satisfying performance payoff.​
